_meta.description: STAGING transcription of the user's 'Inputs' model spreadsheet, photographed 2026-06-09 (IMG_1299-1313). NOT yet merged — used only to build the deviation report against current data. Values are ordered top-to-bottom in the spreadsheet's country order (Germany -> Kazakhstan, 41 rows). null = grey/blank/'no data' cell in the photo. Cells listed in needs_check were obscured, cut off, or ambiguous and must be spot-verified against the photos (or a later .xlsx) before use.

grid_connect_years.notes: Grey-banded rows render as null. MANY rows are 0/grey (likely 'no data'); a literal 0 would falsely make a market best-in-class for this desc factor. Whole column flagged for review; current tool has researched multi-source values for 35 markets.

bandwidth_gbps.notes: Average fibre bandwidth diameter. Same metric as current factor. '/' grey rows = no data -> null.

power_per_capita_kwh.notes: Photo unit 'MW / population 000s' is single-digit scale; current factor is annual kWh/capita (thousands). Different unit -> compare on RANK not value. Sweden value not legible.

grid_investment_usdbn.notes: Photo is annual EUR (absolute); current factor is USD bn over TSO horizon (QA-flagged as full-horizon, not pro-rated). Different basis -> compare on RANK. Read from wide photo, medium confidence.

construction_cost_usd_mw.source: Eurostat, Turner & Townsend, RLB, Cushman & Wakefield
construction_cost_usd_mw.notes: Photo is a normalised $/W index (Switzerland 1.27 = most expensive); current factor is absolute USD/MW. Same direction (higher = costlier). Compare on RANK.

power_cost_usd_kwh.notes: Same metric/unit as current factor. Biggest coverage gain (current 13/48 -> photo ~37). Read at high confidence from sharp crop.

rd_techs_per_million.notes: Same metric as current factor. Left numeric column of the Labour block (Germany 5536, Finland 7871).

tertiary_grad_pct.unit: fraction of tertiary graduates from Engineering/Manufacturing/Construction
tertiary_grad_pct.notes: Photo = STEM SHARE of graduates (0.18 = 18%); current factor = % of population with tertiary attainment (World Bank). DIFFERENT metric -> compare on RANK, and consider whether to swap meaning at all.

demand_addressable.unit: Total Addressable Broadband Demand 2030 (units per spreadsheet; total ~4,510)
demand_addressable.notes: INFORMATIONAL factor (not scored). Photo = addressable broadband demand 2030; current = compute demand 2027 in TWh. Completely different metric/scale -> relabel, do not pretend continuity. Multi-year series (2025/27/30/35/40) available. Baltic rows low confidence.

_not_transcribed.carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh: Photo provides Ember forecast 2027-2030. Current tool already has complete (45/45) Ember-sourced intensity. Skipped transcription (low value, high misalignment risk on the 4-column table); offered to user in ledger.
_not_transcribed.bandwidth_2030_gbps: No clean photo source — left as-is.
_not_transcribed.installed_capacity_mw_IRENASTAT: Available in photos (IMG_1300) but not a scored factor; optional informational add, skipped for now.
_not_transcribed.max_grid_capacity_mw_ENTSOE: Available in photos (IMG_1304) but not scored; optional informational add, skipped for now.
